metas.name: O' Faby
metas.description: O'Faby was the first live action animated movie in Malayalam. It tells the story about the friendship between a boy and an animated character Faby and their adventures.

metas.name: The Legend of Arana
metas.description: Mr. P.N.K Panicker's animated avatar reveals how Arana, the humble red-tailed skink, acquired a famous trait.

metas.name: Watchmaker At Time's End
metas.description: A failed marriage. A watchmaker. Meteorites. Time is uncomfortably relative in this Kerala town, and our hero struggles to make the perfect watch to keep up with the times.
